name: checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>result</code> parameter of a <code>FeatureChainExpression</code> must specialize the feature chain of the <code>FeatureChainExpression</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="let inputParameters : Sequence(Feature) =      ownedFeatures->select(direction = _'in') in let sourceTargetFeature : Feature =      owningExpression.sourceTargetFeature() in sourceTargetFeature <> null and result.subsetsChain(inputParameters->first(), sourceTargetFeature) and result.owningType = self" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>targetFeature</code> of a <code>FeatureChainExpression</code> must be featured within the <code>result</code> parameter of the <code>argument</code> <code>Expression</code> of the <code>FeatureChainExpression</code>.</p>  ">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="argument->notEmpty() implies targetFeature.isFeaturedWithin(argument->first().result)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />

name: deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>targetFeature</code> of a <code>FeatureChainExpression</code> is the <code>memberElement</code> of its first <code>ownedMembership</code> that is not a <code>ParameterMembership</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureChainExpression-deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="targetFeature =     let nonParameterMemberships : Sequence(Membership) = ownedMembership->         reject(oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in     if nonParameterMemberships->isEmpty() or        not nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)     then null     else nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclAsType(Feature)     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureReferenceExpressionReferentIsFeature

            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureReferenceExpression-checkFeatureReferenceExpressionBindingConnector-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>FeatureReferenceExpression</code> must have an <code>ownedMember</code> that is a <code>BindingConnector</code> between the <code>referent</code> and <code>result</code> of the <code>FeatureReferenceExpression</code>.</p>">

</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureReferenceExpressionResultSpecialization

name: deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent

            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureReferenceExpression" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureReferenceExpression-deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>referent</code> of a <code>FeatureReferenceExpression</code> is the <code>memberElement</code> of its first <code>ownedMembership</code> that is not a <code>ParameterMembership</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureReferenceExpression-deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Expressions-FeatureReferenceExpression-deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="referent =     let nonParameterMemberships : Sequence(Membership) = ownedMembership->         reject(oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in     if nonParameterMemberships->isEmpty() or        not nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)     then null     else nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclAsType(Feature)     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureValueBindingConnector

<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-FeatureValues-FeatureValue-checkFeatureValueBindingConnector" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureValueBindingConnector">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-FeatureValues-FeatureValue" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-FeatureValues-FeatureValue-checkFeatureValueBindingConnector-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If <code>isDefault = false</code>, then the <code>featureWithValue</code> must have an <code>ownedMember</code> that is a <code>BindingConnector</code> whose <code>relatedElements</code> are the <code>featureWithValue</code> and a feature chain consisting of the <code>value</code> <code>Expression</code> and its <code>result</code>. If <code>isInitial = false</code>, then this <code>BindingConnector</code> must have <code>featuringTypes</code> that are the same as those of the <code>featureWithValue</code>. If <code>isInitial = true</code>, then the <code>BindingConnector</code> must have <code><em>that.startShot</em><code> as its <code>featuringType</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-FeatureValues-FeatureValue-checkFeatureValueBindingConnector" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-FeatureValues-FeatureValue-checkFeatureValueBindingConnector-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="not isDefault implies     featureWithValue.ownedMember->         selectByKind(BindingConnector)->exists(b |             b.relatedFeature->includes(featureWithValue) and             b.relatedFeature->exists(f |                  f.chainingFeature = Sequence{value, value.result}) and             if not isInitial then                  b.featuringType = featureWithValue.featuringType             else                  b.featuringType->exists(t |                     t.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and                     t.oclAsType(Feature).chainingFeature =                         Sequence{                             resolveGlobal('Base::things::that').                                 memberElement,                             resolveGlobal('Occurrences::Occurrence::startShot').                                 memberElement                         }                 )             endif)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBoundResultTypes-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>results</code> of the <code>bound</code> <code>Expression(s)</code> of a <code>MultiplicityRange</code> must be typed by <code><em>ScalarValues::Intger</em></code> from the Kernel Data Types Library. If a <code>bound</code> is model-level evaluable, then it must evaluate to a non-negative value.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBoundResultTypes" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBoundResultTypes-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="bound->forAll(b |     b.result.specializesFromLibrary('ScalarValues::Integer') and     let value : UnlimitedNatural = valueOf(b) in     value <> null implies value >= 0 )" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateMultiplicityRangeBounds
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBounds" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateMultiplicityRangeBounds">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBounds-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>lowerBound</code> (if any) and <code>upperBound</code> <code>Expressions</code> must be the first <code>ownedMembers</code> of a <code>MultiplicityRange</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBounds" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-validateMultiplicityRangeBounds-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="if lowerBound = null then     ownedMember->notEmpty() and     ownedMember->at(1) = upperBound else     ownedMember->size() > 1 and     ownedMember->at(1) = lowerBound and     ownedMember->at(2) = upperBound endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>MultiplicityRange</code> has one <code>ownedMember</code> that is an <code>Expression</code>, then this is the <code>upperBound</code>. If it has more than one <code>ownedMember</code> that is an <code>Expression</code>, then the <code>upperBound</code> is the second of those. Otherwise, it is null.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="upperBound =     let ownedExpressions : Sequence(Expression) =         ownedMember->selectByKind(Expression) in     if ownedExpressions->isEmpty() then null     else if ownedExpressions->size() = 1 then ownedExpressions->at(1)     else ownedExpressions->at(2)     endif endif " language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveMultiplicityRangeLowerBound
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeLowerBound" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveMultiplicityRangeLowerBound">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeLowerBound-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>MultiplicityRange</code> has two <code>ownedMembers</code> that are <code>Expressions</code>, then the <code>lowerBound</code> is the first of these, otherwise it is <code>null</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeLowerBound" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Multiplicities-MultiplicityRange-deriveMultiplicityRangeLowerBound-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="lowerBound =     let ownedExpressions : Sequence(Expression) =         ownedMember->selectByKind(Expression) in     if ownedExpressions->size() < 2 then null     else ownedExpressions->first()     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveConnectorSourceFeature

name: checkConnectorTypeFeaturing
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-checkConnectorTypeFeaturing" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkConnectorTypeFeaturing">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Connectors-Connector" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-checkConnectorTypeFeaturing-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Each <code>relatedFeature</code> of a <code>Connector</code> must have each <code>featuringType</code> of the <code>Connector</code> as a direct or indirect <code>featuringType</code> (where a <code>Feature</code> with no <code>featuringType</code> is treated as if the <code>Classifier</code> <code><em>Base::Anything</em></code> was its <code>featuringType</code>).</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-checkConnectorTypeFeaturing" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-checkConnectorTypeFeaturing-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="relatedFeature->forAll(f |      if featuringType->isEmpty() then f.isFeaturedWithin(null)     else featuringType->forAll(t | f.isFeaturedWithin(t))     endif)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveConnectorTargetFeature
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorTargetFeature" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveConnectorTargetFeature">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Connectors-Connector" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorTargetFeature-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>targetFeatures</code> of a <code>Connector</code> are the <code>relatedFeatures</code> other than the <code>sourceFeature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorTargetFeature" />
</ownedComment>

</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateConnectorBinarySpecialization

name: validateConnectorRelatedFeatures

name: deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Connectors-Connector" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>defaultFeaturingType</code> of a <code>Connector</code> is the innermost common direct or indirect <code>featuringType</code> of the <code>relatedFeatures</code> of the <code>Connector</code>, so that each <code>relatedElement</code> is featured within the <code>defaultFeaturingType</code>, if such exists.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Connectors-Connector-deriveConnectorDefaultFeaturingType-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="let commonFeaturingTypes : OrderedSet(Type) =      relatedFeature->closure(featuringType)->select(t |          relatedFeature->forAll(f | f.isFeaturedWithin(t))     ) in let nearestCommonFeaturingTypes : OrderedSet(Type) =     commonFeaturingTypes->reject(t1 |          commonFeaturingTypes->exists(t2 |              t2 <> t1 and t2->closure(featuringType)->contains(t1)     )) in if nearestCommonFeaturingTypes->isEmpty() then null else nearestCommonFeaturingTypes->first() endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateClassSpecialization

name: checkMetadataFeatureSemanticSpecialization

<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Kernel-Metadata-MetadataFeature-checkMetadataFeatureSemanticSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkMetadataFeatureSemanticSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Metadata-MetadataFeature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Kernel-Metadata-MetadataFeature-checkMetadataFeatureSemanticSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>MetadataFeature</code> is an application of <code><em>SemanticMetadata</em></code>, then its <code>annotatingElement</code> must be a <code>Type</code>. The annotated <code>Type</code> must then directly or indirectly specialize the specified value of the <code><em>baseType</em></code>, <em>unless</em> the <code>Type</code> is a <code>Classifier</code> and the <code><em>baseType</em></code> represents a kind of <code>Feature</code>, in which case the <code>Classifier</code> must directly or indirectly specialize each of the <code>types</code> of the <code>Feature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Kernel-Metadata-MetadataFeature-checkMetadataFeatureSemanticSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Kernel-Metadata-MetadataFeature-checkMetadataFeatureSemanticSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isSemantic() implies     let annotatedTypes : Sequence(Type) =          annotatedElement->selectAsKind(Type) in     let baseTypes : Sequence(MetadataFeature) =          evaluateFeature(resolveGlobal(             'Metaobjects::SemanticMetadata::baseType').             memberElement.             oclAsType(Feature))->         selectAsKind(MetadataFeature) in     annotatedTypes->notEmpty() and      baseTypes()->notEmpty() and      baseTypes()->first().isSyntactic() implies         let annotatedType : Type = annotatedTypes->first() in         let baseType : Element = baseTypes->first().syntaxElement() in         if annotatedType.oclIsKindOf(Classifier) and              baseType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) then             baseType.oclAsType(Feature).type->                 forAll(t | annotatedType.specializes(t))         else if baseType.oclIsKindOf(Type) then             annotatedType.specializes(baseType.oclAsType(Type))         else             true         endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

</ownedComment>

</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateMetadataFeatureAnnotatedElement

<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Types-Multiplicity-checkMultiplicityTypeFeaturing" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkMultiplicityTypeFeaturing">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Multiplicity" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Types-Multiplicity-checkMultiplicityTypeFeaturing-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If the <code>owningType</code> of a <code>Multiplicity</code> is a <code>Feature</code>, then the <code>Multiplicity</code> must have the same <code>featuringTypes</code> as that <code>Feature</code>. Otherwise, it must have no <code>featuringTypes</code> (meaning that it is implicitly featured by the base <code>Classifier</code> <em><code>Anything</code></em>).</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Multiplicity-checkMultiplicityTypeFeaturing" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Types-Multiplicity-checkMultiplicityTypeFeaturing-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="if owningType <> null and owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) then     featuringType =          owningType.oclAsType(Feature).featuringType else     featuringType->isEmpty() endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkMultiplicitySpecialization
xml:

</ownedComment>

          </ownedRule>

name: validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain

<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Classifiers-Classifier-validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain">

</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Classifiers-Classifier-validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="multiplicity <> null implies multiplicity.featuringType->isEmpty()" language="OCL2.0" name="" />

name: validateRedefinitionEndConformance
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionEndConformance" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateRedefinitionEndConformance">

            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionEndConformance-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If the redefinedFeature of a Redefinition has isEnd = true, then the redefiningFeature must have isEnd = true.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionEndConformance" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionEndConformance-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="redefinedFeature.isEnd implies redefiningFeature.isEnd" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Redefinition" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>redefiningFeature</code> of a <code>Redefinition</code> must have at least one <code>featuringType</code> that is not also a <code>featuringType</code> of the <code>redefinedFeature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="let anythingType: Type =     redefiningFeature.resolveGlobal('Base::Anything').modelElement.oclAsType(Type) in  -- Including "Anything" accounts for implicit featuringType of Features -- with no explicit featuringType. let redefiningFeaturingTypes: Set(Type) =     if redefiningFeature.isVariable then Set{redefiningFeature.owningType}     else redefiningFeature.featuringTypes->asSet()->including(anythingType)      endif in let redefinedFeaturingTypes: Set(Type) =     if redefinedFeature.isVariable then Set{redefinedFeature.owningType}     else redefinedFeature.featuringTypes->asSet()->including(anythingType)     endif in redefiningFeaturingTypes <> redefinedFeaturingType" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Redefinition" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If the <code>redefinedFeature</code> of a <code>Redefinition</code> has a direction of <code>in</code> or <code>out</code> (relative to any <code>featuringType</code> of the <code>redefiningFeature</code> or the <code>owningType</code>, if the <code>redefiningFeature</code> has <code>isVariable = true</code>), then the <code>redefiningFeature</code> must have the same <code>direction</code>. If the <code>redefinedFeature</code> has a direction of <code>inout</code>, then the <code>redefiningFeature</code> must have a non-null <code>direction</code>. (Note: the direction of the <code>redefinedFeature</code> relative to a <code>featuringType</code> of the <code>redefiningFeature</code> is the direction it would have if it had been inherited and not redefined.)</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Redefinition-validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="let featuringTypes : Sequence(Type) =     if redefiningFeature.isVariable then Sequence{redefiningFeature.owningType}     else redefiningFeature.featuringType     endif in featuringTypes->forAll(t |     let direction : FeatureDirectionKind = t.directionOf(redefinedFeature) in     ((direction = FeatureDirectionKind::_'in' or        direction = FeatureDirectionKind::out) implies          redefiningFeature.direction = direction)     and      (direction = FeatureDirectionKind::inout implies         redefiningFeature.direction <> null))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureCrossingSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureCrossingSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureCrossingSpecialization">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureCrossingSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>Feature</code> has <code>isEnd = true</code> and <code>ownedCrossFeature</code> returns a non-null value, then the <code>crossFeature</code> of the <code>Feature</code> must be the <code>Feature</code> returned from <code>ownedCrossFeature</code> (which implies that this <code>Feature</code> has an appropriate <code>ownedCrossSubsetting</code> to realize this).</p>">

</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureCrossingSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedCrossFeature() <> null implies crossFeature = ownedCrossFeature()" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureParameterRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureParameterRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> is a <code>parameter</code> of an <code>owningType</code> that is a <code>Behavior</code> or <code>Step</code>, but <em>not</em> </p> <ul>     <li>A <code>result</code> <code>parameter</code></li>     <li>A <code>parameter</code> of an <code>InvocationExpression</code>, with at least one non-implied <code>ownedRedefinition</code></li> </ul> <p>then, for each direct supertype of its <code>owningType</code> that is also a <code>Behavior</code> or <code>Step</code>, it must redefine the <code>parameter</code> at the same position, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="owningType <> null and not owningFeatureMembership.     oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership) and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) and     (owningType.oclIsKindOf(InvocationExpression) implies       not ownedRedefinition->exists(not isImplied))  implies     let i : Integer =         owningType.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->             reject(owningFeatureMembership.                 oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership))->             indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |             let ownedParameters : Sequence(Feature) =                 supertype.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->                      reject(owningFeatureMembership.                          oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in             ownedParameters->size() >= i implies                 redefines(ownedParameters->at(i))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>
