name: checkFeatureEndRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureEndRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has <code>isEnd = true</code> and an <code>owningType</code> that is not empty, then, for each direct supertype of its <code>owningType</code>, it must redefine the <code>endFeature</code> at the same position, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isEnd and owningType <> null implies     let i : Integer =          owningType.ownedEndFeature->indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |              supertype.endFeature->size() >= i implies                 redefines(supertype.endFeature->at(i))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureValuationSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureValuationSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureValuationSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureValuationSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has a <code>FeatureValue</code>, no <code>ownedSpecializations</code> that are not implied, and is not directed, then it must specialize the <code>result</code> of the <code>value</code> <code>Expression</code> of the <code>FeatureValue</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureValuationSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureValuationSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="direction = null and ownedSpecializations->forAll(isImplied) implies     ownedMembership->         selectByKind(FeatureValue)->         forAll(fv | specializes(fv.value.result))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>Feature</code> is the <code>ownedCrossFeature</code> of an end <code>Feature</code>, then it must directly or indirectly specialize the <code>types</code> of its owning end <code>Feature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isOwnedCrossFeature() implies owner.oclAsType(Feature).type->forAll(t | self.specializes(t))" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureType
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureType" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureCrossFeatureType">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureType-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>crossFeature</code> of a <code>Feature</code> must have the same <code>types</code> as the <code>Feature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureType" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureType-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="crossFeature <> null implies crossFeature.type->asSet() = type->asSet()" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has a <code>multiplicity</code>, then the <code>featuringTypes</code> of the <code>multiplicity</code> must be the same as those of the <code>Feature</code> itself.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="multiplicity <> null implies multiplicity.featuringType = featuringType " language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Each <code>chainingFeature</code> (other than the first) must be featured within the previous <code>chainingFeature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="Sequence{2..chainingFeature->size()}->forAll(i | chainingFeature->at(i).isFeaturedWithin(chainingFeature->at(i-1))) " language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureCrossFeature
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureCrossFeature" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureCrossFeature">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureCrossFeature-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>crossFeature</code> of a <code>Feature</code> is the second <code>chainingFeature</code> of the <code>crossedFeature</code> of the <code>ownedCrossSubsetting</code> of the <code>Feature</code>, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureCrossFeature" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureCrossFeature-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="crossFeature =     if ownedCrossSubsetting = null then null     else          let chainingFeatures: Sequence(Feature) =              ownedCrossSubsetting.crossedFeature.chainingFeature in         if chainingFeatures->size() < 2 then null         else chainingFeatures->at(2)     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureConstantIsVariable
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureConstantIsVariable" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureConstantIsVariable">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureConstantIsVariable-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>Feature</code> with <code>isConstant = true</code> must have <code>isVariable = true</code>.">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureConstantIsVariable" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureConstantIsVariable-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isConstant implies isVariable" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeaturePortionNotVariable
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeaturePortionNotVariable" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeaturePortionNotVariable">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeaturePortionNotVariable-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isPortion implies not isVariable" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedSubsettings</code> of a <code>Feature</code> are its <code>ownedSpecializations</code> that are <code>Subsettings</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedSubsetting = ownedSpecialization->selectByKind(Subsetting)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>Feature</code> cannot be one of its own <code>chainingFeatures</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="chainingFeature->excludes(self)" language="English" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedCrossSubsetting</code> of a <code>Feature</code> is the <code>ownedSubsetting</code> that is a <code>CrossSubsetting</code>, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedCrossSubsetting =     let crossSubsettings: Sequence(CrossSubsetting) =          ownedSubsetting->selectByKind(CrossSubsetting) in     if crossSubsettings->isEmpty() then null     else crossSubsettings->first()     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureFeaturingType
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeaturingType" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureFeaturingType">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeaturingType-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="The <code>featuringTypes</code> of a <code>Feature</code> include the <code>featuringTypes</code> of all the <code>typeFeaturings</code> of the <code>Feature</code>. If the <code>Feature</code> has <code>chainingFeatures</code>, then its <code>featuringTypes</code> also include the <code>featuringTypes</code> of the first <code>chainingFeature</code>.">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeaturingType" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeaturingType-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="featuringType =     let featuringTypes : OrderedSet(Type) =          featuring.type->asOrderedSet() in     if chainingFeature->isEmpty() then featuringTypes     else         featuringTypes->             union(chainingFeature->first().featuringType)->             asOrderedSet()     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureResultRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureResultRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> is a <code>result</code> <code>parameter</code> of an <code>owningType</code> that is a <code>Function</code> or <code>Expression</code>, then, for each direct supertype of its <code>owningType</code> that is also a <code>Function</code> or <code>Expression</code>, it must redefine the <code>result</code> <code>parameter</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Function) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Function).result or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Expression).result) implies     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         select(oclIsKindOf(Function) or oclIsKindOf(Expression))->         forAll(supertype |             redefines(                 if superType.oclIsKindOf(Function) then                     superType.oclAsType(Function).result                 else                     superType.oclAsType(Expression).result                 endif)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureOwnedTyping
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTyping" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureOwnedTyping">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTyping-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedTypings</code> of a <code>Feature</code> are its <code>ownedSpecializations</code> that are <code>FeatureTypings</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTyping" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTyping-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedTyping = ownedGeneralization->selectByKind(FeatureTyping)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeaturePortionSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeaturePortionSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeaturePortionSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeaturePortionSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has <code>isPortion = true</code>, an <code>ownedTyping </code> relationship to a <code>Class</code>, and an <code>owningType</code> that is a <code>Class</code> or another <code>Feature</code> typed by a <code>Class</code>, then it must directly or indirectly specialize <em><code>Occurrences::Occurrence::portions</code></em> from the Kernel Semantic Library.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeaturePortionSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeaturePortionSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isPortion and ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Class)) and owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Class) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and     owningType.oclAsType(Feature).type->         exists(oclIsKindOf(Class))) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::portions')" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureEndSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureEndSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has <code>isEnd = true</code> and an <code>owningType</code> that is an <code>Association</code> or a <code>Connector</code>, then it must directly or indirectly specialize <code><em>Links::Link::participant</em></code> from the Kernel Semantic Library.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isEnd and owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Association) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Connector)) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Links::Link::participant')" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureType
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureType" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureType">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureType-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>types</code> of a <code>Feature</code> are the union of the <code>types</code> of its <code>typings</code> and the <code>types</code> of the <code>Features</code> it subsets, with all redundant supertypes removed. If the <code>Feature</code> has <code>chainingFeatures</code>, then the union also includes the types of the last <code>chainingFeature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureType" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureType-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="type =      let types : OrderedSet(Types) = OrderedSet{self}->         -- Note: The closure operation automatically handles circular relationships.         closure(typingFeatures()).typing.type->asOrderedSet() in     types->reject(t1 | types->exist(t2 | t2 <> t1 and t2.specializes(t1)))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>Feature</code> must have at most one <code>ownedSubsetting</code> that is a <code>CrossSubsetting</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedSubsetting->selectByKind(CrossSubsetting)->size() <= 1" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A composite <code>Feature</code> that has an <code>ownedTyping</code> relationship to a <code>Class</code>, and whose <code>ownedType</code> is a <code>Class</code> or another <code>Feature</code> typed by a <code>Class</code>, must directly or indirectly specialize <em><code>Occurrences::Occurrence::suboccurrences</code></em>.">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isComposite and ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Class)) and owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Class) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and     owningType.oclAsType(Feature).type->         exists(oclIsKindOf(Class))) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::suboccurrences')" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedReferenceSubsetting</code> of a <code>Feature</code> is the first <code>ownedSubsetting</code> that is a <code>ReferenceSubsetting</code> (if any).</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedReferenceSubsetting =     let referenceSubsettings : OrderedSet(ReferenceSubsetting) =         ownedSubsetting->selectByKind(ReferenceSubsetting) in     if referenceSubsettings->isEmpty() then null     else referenceSubsettings->first() endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A composite <code>Feature</code> typed by a <code>Structure</code>, and whose <code>ownedType</code> is a <code>Structure</code> or another <code>Feature</code> typed by a <code>Structure</code> must directly or indirectly specialize <em><code>Objects::Object::subobjects</code></em>.">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isComposite and ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Structure)) and owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Structure) or  owningType.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Structure))) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::suboccurrences')" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>Feature</code> has a <code>crossFeature</code>, then, for any <code>Feature</code> that is redefined by this <code>Feature</code>, the <code>crossFeature</code> must specialize the <code>crossFeature</code> of the redefined end <code>Feature</code>, if this exists.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="crossFeature <> null implies     ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature.crossFeature->             forAll(f | f <> null implies crossFeature.specializes(f))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedTypeFeaturings</code> of a <code>Feature</code> are its <code>ownedRelationships</code> that are <code>TypeFeaturings</code> and which have the <code>Feature</code> as their <code>featureOfType</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedTypeFeaturing = ownedRelationship->selectByKind(TypeFeaturing)-> select(tf | tf.featureOfType = self)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>Feature</code> must have at most one <code>ownedSubsetting</code> that is an <code>ReferenceSubsetting</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedSubsetting->selectByKind(ReferenceSubsetting)->size() <= 1" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has an <code>ownedTyping</code> relationship to a <code>DataType</code>, then it must directly or indirectly specialize <code><em>Base::dataValues</em></code> from the Kernel Semantic Library.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedTyping.type->exists(selectByKind(DataType)) implies specializesFromLibrary('Base::dataValues')" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> is the first <code>ownedFeature</code> of a first or second <code>FlowEnd</code>, then it must directly or indirectly specialize either <em><code>Transfers::Transfer::source::sourceOutput</code></em> or <em><code>Transfers::Transfer::target::targetInput</code></em>, respectively, from the Kernel Semantic Library.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="owningType <> null and owningType.oclIsKindOf(FlowEnd) and owningType.ownedFeature->at(1) = self implies     let flowType : Type = owningType.owningType in     flowType <> null implies         let i : Integer =              flowType.ownedFeature.indexOf(owningType) in         (i = 1 implies              redefinesFromLibrary('Transfers::Transfer::source::sourceOutput')) and         (i = 2 implies             redefinesFromLibrary('Transfers::Transfer::source::targetInput'))                  " language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveFeatureFeatureTarget
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeatureTarget" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveFeatureFeatureTarget">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeatureTarget-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has no <code>chainingFeatures</code>, then its <code>featureTarget</code> is the <code>Feature</code> itself, otherwise the <code>featureTarget</code> is the last of the <code>chainingFeatures</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeatureTarget" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-deriveFeatureFeatureTarget-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="featureTarget = if chainingFeature->isEmpty() then self else chainingFeature->last() endif" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureEndMultiplicity
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndMultiplicity" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureEndMultiplicity">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndMultiplicity-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has <code>isEnd = true</code>, then it must have multiplicity <code>1..1</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndMultiplicity" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndMultiplicity-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isEnd implies multiplicities().allSuperTypes()->flatten()-> selectByKind(MultiplicityRange)->exists(hasBounds(1,1))" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>Feature</code> is the <code>ownedCrossFeature</code> of an end <code>Feature</code>, then it must have <code>featuringTypes</code> consistent with the crossing from other end <code>Features</code> of the <code>owningType</code> of its end <code>Feature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isOwnedCrossFeature() implies     let otherEnds : OrderedSet(Feature) =          owner.oclAsType(Feature).owningType.endFeature->excluding(self) in     if (otherEnds->size() = 1) then         featuringType = otherEnds->first().type     else         featuringType->size() = 1 and         featuringType->first().isCartesianProduct() and         featuringType->first().asCartesianProduct() = otherEnds.type and         featuringType->first().allSupertypes()->includesAll(             owner.oclAsType(Feature).ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->                select(crossFeature() <> null).crossFeature().featuringType)           endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>Feature</code> is the <code>ownedCrossFeature</code> of an end <code>Feature</code>, then, for any end <code>Feature</code> that is redefined by the owning end <code>Feature</code> of this <code>Feature</code>, this <code>Feature</code> must subset the <code>crossFeature</code> of the redefined end <code>Feature</code>, if this exists.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isOwnedCrossFeature() implies     ownedSubsetting.subsettedFeature->includesAll(         owner.oclAsType(Feature).ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->             select(crossFeature <> null).crossFeature)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> is owned via a <code>FeatureMembership</code>, then it must have a <code>featuringType</code> for which the operation <code>isFeaturingType</code> returns true.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="owningFeatureMembership <> null implies featuringTypes->exists(t | isFeaturingType(t))" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>Feature</code> with <code>isEnd = true</code> must have all of <code>isDerived = false</code>, <code>isAbstract = false</code>, <code>isComposite = false</code>, and <code>isPortion = false</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isEnd implies not (isDerived or isAbstract or isComposite or isPortion)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureSpecialization
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSpecialization" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureSpecialization">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSpecialization-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>A <code>Feature</code> must directly or indirectly specialize <code><em>Base::things</em></code> from the Kernel Semantic Library.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSpecialization" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureSpecialization-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="specializesFromLibrary('Base::things')" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateSubsettingConstantConformance
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingConstantConformance" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateSubsettingConstantConformance">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Subsetting" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingConstantConformance-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If the <code>subsettedFeature</code> of a <code>Subsetting</code> has <code>isConstant = true</code> and the <code>subsettingFeature</code> has <code>isVariable = true</code>, then the <code>subsettingFeature</code> must have <code>isConstant = true</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingConstantConformance" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingConstantConformance-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="subsettedFeature.isConstant and subsettingFeature.isVariable implies subsettingFeature.isConstant " language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Subsetting" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If the <code>subsettedFeature</code> of a <code>Subsetting</code> has <code>isUnique = true</code>, then the <code>subsettingFeature</code> must have <code>isUnique = true</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="subsettedFeature.isUnique implies subsettingFeature.isUnique" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Subsetting" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>subsettedFeature</code> must be accessible by the <code>subsettingFeature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Subsetting-validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="subsettingFeature.canAccess(subsettedFeature)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-EndFeatureMembership-validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-EndFeatureMembership" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-EndFeatureMembership-validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedMemberFeature</code> of an <code>EndFeatureMembership</code> must be an end <code>Feature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-EndFeatureMembership-validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-EndFeatureMembership-validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedMemberFeature.isEnd" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>crossedFeature</code> of a <code>CrossSubsetting</code> must have exactly two <code>chainingFeatures</code>. If the <code>crossingFeature</code> of the <code>CrossSubsetting</code> is one of two end <code>Features</code>, then the first <code>chainingFeature</code> must be the other end <code>Feature</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="crossingFeature.isEnd and crossingFeature.owningType <> null implies     let endFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = crossingFeature.owningType.endFeature in     let chainingFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = crossedFeature.chainingFeature in     chainingFeatures->size() = 2 and     endFeatures->size() = 2 implies          chainingFeatures->at(1) = endFeatures->excluding(crossingFeature)->at(1)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>crossingFeature</code> of a <code>CrossSubsetting</code> must be an end <code>Feature</code> that is owned by a <code>Type</code> with at least two end <code>Features</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-CrossSubsetting-validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="crossingFeature.isEnd and crossingFeature.owningType<>null and crossingFeature.owningType.endFeature ->size() > 1" language="OCL2.0" name="">
            </specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveAnnotationOwnedAnnotatingElement
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationOwnedAnnotatingElement" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveAnnotationOwnedAnnotatingElement">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationOwnedAnnotatingElement-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedAnnotatingElement</code> of an <code>Annotation</code> is the first <code>ownedRelatedElement</code> that is an <code>AnnotatingElement</code>, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationOwnedAnnotatingElement" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationOwnedAnnotatingElement-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedAnnotatingElement =     let ownedAnnotatingElements : Sequence(AnnotatingElement) =          ownedRelatedElement->selectByKind(AnnotatingElement) in     if ownedAnnotatingElements->isEmpty() then null     else ownedAnnotatingElements->first()     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Either the <code>ownedAnnotatingElement</code> of an <code>Annotation</code> must be non-null, or the <code>owningAnnotatingElement</code> must be non-null, but not both.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedAnnotatingElement <> null xor owningAnnotatingElement <> null" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>An <code>Annotation</code> owns its <code>annotatingElement</code> if and only if it is owned by its <code>annotatedElement</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="(owningAnnotatedElement <> null) = (ownedAnnotatingElement <> null)" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveAnnotationAnnotatingElement
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationAnnotatingElement" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveAnnotationAnnotatingElement">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationAnnotatingElement-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>annotatingElement</code> of an <code>Annotation</code> is either its <code>ownedAnnotatingElement</code> or its <code>owningAnnotatingElement</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationAnnotatingElement" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-Annotation-deriveAnnotationAnnotatingElement-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="annotatingElement = if ownedAnnotatingElement <> null then ownedAnnotatingElement else owningAnnotatingElement endif" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotation
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotation" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotation">
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotation-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>annotations</code> of an <code>AnnotatingElement</code> are its <code>owningAnnotatingRelationship</code> (if any) followed by all its <code>ownedAnnotatingRelationships</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotation" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotation-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="annotation =      if owningAnnotatingRelationship = null then ownedAnnotatingRelationship     else owningAnnotatingRelationship->prepend(owningAnnotatingRelationship)     endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotatedElement
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotatedElement" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotatedElement">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotatedElement-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If an <code>AnnotatingElement</code> has <code>annotations</code>, then its <code>annotatedElements</code> are the <code>annotatedElements</code> of all its <code>annotations</code>. Otherwise, it's single <code>annotatedElement</code> is its <code>owningNamespace</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotatedElement" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementAnnotatedElement-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="annotatedElement = if annotation->notEmpty() then annotation.annotatedElement else Sequence{owningNamespace} endif" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: deriveAnnotatingElementOwnedAnnotatingRelationship
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementOwnedAnnotatingRelationship" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveAnnotatingElementOwnedAnnotatingRelationship">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementOwnedAnnotatingRelationship-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>ownedAnnotatingRelationships</code> of an <code>AnnotatingElement</code> are its <code>ownedRelationships</code> that are <code>Annotations</code>, for which the <code>AnnotatingElement</code> is not the <code>annotatedElement</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementOwnedAnnotatingRelationship" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Annotations-AnnotatingElement-deriveAnnotatingElementOwnedAnnotatingRelationship-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedAnnotatingRelationship = ownedRelationship->     selectByKind(Annotation)->     select(a | a.annotatedElement <> self)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-NamespaceImport-importedMemberships_Namespace-unnamed1" />

name: deriveNamespaceImportImportedElement
xml:

name: deriveElementQualifiedName
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-deriveElementQualifiedName" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveElementQualifiedName">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Root-Elements-Element" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-deriveElementQualifiedName-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If this <code>Element</code> does not have an <code>owningNamespace</code>, then its <code>qualifiedName</code> is null. If the <code>owningNamespace</code> of this Element is a root <code>Namespace</code>, then the <code>qualifiedName</code> of the <code>Element</code> is the escaped name of the <code>Element</code> (if any). If the <code>owningNamespace</code> is non-null but not a root <code>Namespace</code>, then the <code>qualifiedName</code> of this <code>Element</code> is constructed from the <code>qualifiedName</code> of the <code>owningNamespace</code> and the escaped name of the <code>Element</code>, unless the <code>qualifiedName</code> of the <code>owningNamespace</code> is null or the escaped name is null, in which case the <code>qualifiedName</code> of this <code>Element</code> is also null. Further, if the <code>owningNamespace</code> has other <code>ownedMembers</code> with the same non-null name as this <code>Element</code>, and this <code>Element</code> is not the first, then the <code>qualifiedName</code> of this <code>Element</code> is null.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Elements-Element-deriveElementQualifiedName" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-deriveElementQualifiedName-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="qualifiedName =     if owningNamespace = null then null     else if name <> null and          owningNamespace.ownedMember->         select(m | m.name = name).indexOf(self) <> 1 then null     else if owningNamespace.owner = null then escapedName()     else if owningNamespace.qualifiedName = null or              escapedName() = null then null     else owningNamespace.qualifiedName + '::' + escapedName()     endif endif endif endif" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>
